loreLimits: Game incarnation Emissary from Predator: Hunting Grounds, released April19 2022. Distinct from the two cut-film Emissary designs of The Predator.
Body equipment extrapolates the partly occluded lower legs/back from official key art. Artistic reconstruction, no certified1:1 claim.
Only idle has six authored frames in each direction. Movement, attacks and round performances remain incomplete and use an explicitly declared native stance.
No invented exclusive canonical location: existing Hunting Grounds shared location association remains unchanged.

accepted.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent full-body 2D fighting-game character cutout for THE PIT, Emissary Predator from Predator: Hunting Grounds.
Input image role: official PlayStation/IllFonic Emissary DLC key artwork. Follow THIS game incarnation, not either movie deleted-scene Emissary.
Primary request: render the same Emissary in a calm ready-to-fight stance, full body, facing screen RIGHT in a readable lateral three-quarter view, feet grounded on one horizontal baseline. Preserve the official glossy black graphite biomasque silhouette: smooth domed crown, two modest crown corners, silver/gold-edged brow ridges, narrow eyes, long vented triangular lower face, black braided dreadlocks with small metal cuffs. Preserve tan spotted Yautja skin, sleeveless woodland camouflage tactical vest with segmented chest/abdomen plates, olive/camouflage shoulder caps, broad utility belt and two thigh pouches, camouflage trousers, dark worn shin protection and clawed bare feet. Lower shin details and hidden surfaces are a restrained reconstruction because not fully visible in the reference; do not add fantasy ornament.
Anatomical RIGHT forearm carries the two slim wrist blades shown in the source. Anatomical LEFT arm has its existing bracer and an empty relaxed clawed hand. Hands have coherent fingers/thumbs, wrists align with forearms, no fused or extra limbs. Right wrist blades are compact, lowered and point generally toward the opponent, not across the face. Two arms, two legs, same equipment throughout. Do not invent guns, swords, skull trophies, magic, capes, horns, teeth on the mask or new spikes.
Style: detailed painted game sprite, slightly outlined silhouette, restrained realistic proportions matching the source, not a toy photo or chibi. Soft neutral studio lighting, no colored backlight.
Composition: portrait 1024x1536, entire body including dreadlocks, fingers, blades and toes within generous transparent margins, body fills about82% of height. Body never cut at edges. Camera at waist height, no fisheye.
Background must be real transparent alpha. No stage, floor, drop shadow, checkerboard, text, logos, captions, watermark, frame or reference thumbnail. One single character only.
accepted.visualNotes: Primary-reference mask/camouflage maintained. Two right-wrist blades, left wrist bare. Complete unclipped silhouette.

accepted.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: native transparent 2D fighting-game idle animation spritesheet, Emissary Predator Hunting Grounds, screen RIGHT facing.
Image1 is the accepted character design to preserve, Image2 the official identity reference. Create a complete 6-frame calm idle breathing cycle of exactly this same character in a readable lateral three-quarter RIGHT-facing duel stance, 3 columns by 2 rows on a1536x1024 canvas, each cell512x512, no gutters or labels. This is one spritesheet asset.
Each frame is a separately drawn natural pose with small distinct chest breathing, elbow/wrist settling and slight dreadlock follow-through; ordered1-6 left-to-right top-to-bottom. Calm grounded fighter, not attacking. Feet stay planted in the SAME positions on cell baseline y470, center body around x256; headtoparoundy55. Match body size from frame to frame and keep full body inside every cell with at least24px transparent edge margin. Opponent is clearly screen RIGHT: nose, chest and forward toes look right. Same graphite rounded mask with paired small crown corners and silver/gold trim, black cuffed dreadlocks, spotted tan skin, camouflage military vest/trousers/pouches, brown shin guards and clawed feet as Image1. Anatomical RIGHT wrist has exactly TWO metal blades; LEFT wrist does NOT gain blades, and LEFT hand is empty. Preserve correct anatomical sides across poses. Five coherent digits per hand including thumb; no extra fingers or merged palms; no added shoulder gun if concealed in accepted design. No costume change, no helmet variation, no glow, no smoking weapon, no extra props.
Painted outlined detailed 2D game sprite, neutral lighting consistent across all six poses. Background fully transparent alpha. No decorative backdrop, floor, shadow, checkerboard, gridline, caption, logos, labels, watermark, frames or thumbnail. All six complete silhouettes fit and remain separated. The anatomy, mask and equipment must be coherent in each frame.
Mandatory correction from a rejected attempt: figures were too large and touched the horizontal boundary, cutting toes. In this new version leave the UPPER QUARTER and LOWER EIGHTH of EACH CELL empty transparent. Each character must fit inside x80..432 and y100..430 of its own512x512cell. Body height only330pixels. There must be at least80pixels of completely transparent vertical space between upper-row feet and lower-row helmet. Never enlarge the characters to fill the grid. The canvas is1536x1024 with3by2cells. SIX complete, smaller figures surrounded by plenty of empty alpha. Keep all limbs, both feet, both blades and dreadlocks untouched within each isolated cell. This empty space is required for animation safety.
accepted.visualNotes: Six subtle guarded breathing drawings, independent side. Equipment and anatomy inspected. Strict cell-boundary measurement required.
